summary_en: ITG-G Holdings raised its tender offer price for Kadoya Sesame Mills from 2,514 yen to 2,655 yen per share and extended the offer period from 39 to 47 business days, ending November 26, 2026, citing market stock price trends and application status.
title_en: Notice of Partial Revision of "Notice of Statement of Support and Recommendation for Application regarding the Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by ITG-G Holdings Co., Ltd."
translation_en_brief:
ITG-G Holdings Co., Ltd., the tender offeror, increased its acquisition price for Kadoya Sesame Mills shares from 2,514 yen to 2,655 yen per share on November 6, 2026. The minimum number of shares to be acquired remains 13,847,100. The tender offer period was simultaneously extended from 39 business days (originally ending November 13, 2026) to 47 business days, now concluding on November 26, 2026.

The price increase was decided after reviewing market stock price movements, shareholder application status in the tender offer since its launch, and future application prospects. The offeror submitted a binding repricing proposal to Kadoya Sesame Mills on November 6 in response to an earlier solicitation for price reconsideration. On November 11, the offeror filed an amendment to the tender offer statement with the financial authorities, formally implementing these changes. The objective of the transaction remains the delisting of Kadoya Sesame Mills shares through a public tender offer followed by squeeze-out procedures under the Companies Act.
